Further to our prior discussions with Arifin, we would like to summarise the agreed arrangements as follows: Facility Usage ATA Medical Clinic (Novena) will utilise: Ultrasound Room 1 as the GP consultation room The Sono Charting Room as the ECG / phlebotomy / treatment room Asiamedic will not charge rental for the use of the above rooms. In Consideration, ATA Medical Clinic (Novena) will: Refer diagnostic imaging services at the following agreed discount rates: Mammogram and Ultrasound: 15% discount CT and MRI: 20% discount X-Ray: 20% discount (excluding Chest X-Ray) Chest X-Ray (1 View) only: 30% discount Chest X-Ray [Filmless]: $15 (newly proposed) Support Asiamedic Sunway Imaging with GP consultation services at $20 per consult  for chiropractic X-ray referrals Provide support in the management of patients with acute allergic reactions to contrast, in situations where a radiologist is not available onsite. These arrangements will be in place for a committed period of one (1) year, after which both parties may review the terms. Do let me know if you are agreeable to the above stated and whether there should be other points to add on. Thank you once again, and we look forward to working closely with you.
